source: At first glance, latent compression seems to save storage only by adding decompression work: reconstructZXMATH0000XZ andZXMATH0001XZ fromZXMATH0002XZ every time they are needed. ZXNAME0000XZ avoids that naive implementation through associativity of matrix multiplication.ZXMATH0003XZ
zh: 乍一看，潜在压缩似乎仅通过添加解压缩工作来节省存储：每次需要时从 ZXMATH0002XZ 重建 ZXMATH0000XZ 和 ZXMATH0001XZ。 ZXNAME0000XZ 通过矩阵乘法的结合性避免了这种幼稚的实现。ZXMATH0003XZ
